parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of Meta.ordering fields being included in the GROUP BY clause, but it introduces a conditional check that may not fully resolve the underlying problem.

issues.description: The PR introduces a conditional check based on `self.query.default_ordering`, which may not cover all cases where Meta.ordering fields should not be included in the GROUP BY clause. This could lead to functional incompleteness.
